senses.gloss: (b. h.) to range, arrange, place in order.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 2:4:3">Y. Yoma II, end, 40ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Leviticus 1:8">Lev. I, 8</cite>, a.
<cite ref="Leviticus 1:12">12</cite>) <he>כהן אחד עוֹרֵךְ וכ׳</he> one priest places two limbs on the altar &c.; Sifra Vayikra, N’dab., Par. 4, ch. VI.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 78:7">Gen. R. s. 78</cite> <he>יש בי כח לעֲרוֹךְ תפלה</he> (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 133:10">Yalk. ib. 133</cite> <he>לסדר</he>) I have strength to offer prayer; <he>יש בי כח לערוך מלחמה</he> I have strength to give battle. Yalk. l. c. <he>וע׳ מלחמה כנגדו</he> gave him battle. Tanḥ.
<cite ref="Leviticus 6">B’ḥuck. 6</cite> <he>ואֶעֱרוֹךְ לפניכם שלחן</he> I will set a table before you (in the hereafter), v. infra.

Ned. 20ᵇ עָרַכְתִּי לו שלחן והפכו I prepared a table for him, but he upset it (euphem. for unnatural gratification); a. e. [In Talm. mostly סדר.]—עוֹרְכֵי הדיינין (= עורכי דין לפני הדיינין) those who arrange arguments before the judges, pleaders, advocates, who advise their clients what to say or not to say before court.

<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 1:8">Ab. I, 8</cite> <he>אל תעש עצמך כע׳ הד׳</he> do not make thyself to be like legal advisers, i.e. be careful as judge not to suggest an advice to one of the litigants; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Batra 9:4:3">Y. B. Bath. IX, 17ᵃ</cite> top <he>כעֹרְכֵי</he>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 4:10:4">Y. Keth. IV, 29ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>אל תעש עצמך כע׳ הד׳ שלא לגלות וכ׳</he> do not make thyself to be like &c., that is, you must not reveal to an individual his case (how to argue). Bab.

<cite ref="Ketubot 52b">Keth. 52ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Ketubot 86a:2">86ᵃ</cite> <he>עשינו עצמינו כע׳ ד׳</he> we have made ourselves to be like &c. (I ought not to have suggested an advice).—Part. pass. <he>עָרוּךְ</he>; f. <cite ref="P01324"><he>עְרוּכָה</he></cite> &c.

Sabb. 119ᵇ וכשבא לביתו ומצא נר דלוק ושלחן ע׳ וכ׳ when he comes home and finds the lamp lighted, the table set and the couch spread, the good angel says &c.; a. e.—2) (cmp. Syr. ערך, P. Sm. 2990) to work dough (contrad. to לוּשׁ); to roll, shape &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 3:4">Pes. III, 4</cite> <he>אחת לשה ואחת עוֹרֶכֶת וכ׳</he> one woman kneads, another works and shapes the dough, and a third one bakes.
<cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 4:9">Ab. Zar. IV, 9</cite> <he>לא לשין ולא עוֹרְכִין עמו</he> you must not knead nor work and shape dough with him.
<cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 2:4">Neg. II, 4</cite> <he>כעוֹרֶכֶת</he> in the position of a woman working dough; a. fr.—Part. pass. as ab.

<cite ref="Eruvin 54a">Erub. 54ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <he>ערוכה וכ׳</he>, <cite ref="II Samuel 23:5">II Sam. XXIII, 5</cite>) <he>אם ע׳ … משתמרת וכ׳</he> if the Law is worked into thy two hundred and forty-eight limbs, it will be preserved &c.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 14">Midr. Till. to Ps. XIV</cite> [read:] <he>פת לושה ופת ע׳</he> kneaded (common) bread and well-worked bread; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 662">Yalk. ib. 662</cite> <cite ref="P01357"><he>עריכה</he></cite> (corr. acc.).

senses.gloss: [to place side by side; cmp. נָקַשׁ Hif.] to compare; to value; esp. (v.
units: Lev. XXVII, 2-13) to dedicate the value of a person or of an animal unfit for the altar.
<cite ref="Mishnah Arakhin 1:1">Arakh. I, 1</cite> <he>הכל מַעֲרִיכִין ונֶעֱרָכִין</he> all persons are fit to dedicate or to be the subjects of dedication.

<cite ref="Mishnah Arakhin 1:1">Ib.</cite> <he>נֶעֱרָךְ אבל לא מַעֲרִיךְ</he> may be the subject of dedication, but cannot dedicate (his vow is invalid). Ib. VI, 5 <he>המעריך את עצמו</he> he who dedicates his own value. Tanḥ. l. c. [read:] <he>אתם מעריכין לפני את נפשותיכם … מעריכת גיהנם</he> you value before me your lives, and I shall save you from the range of Gehenna (v. <cite ref="P01357"><he>עֲרִיכָה</he></cite>), and set &c. (v. supra); a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be the subject of valuation, to be valued.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Arakhin 1:1">Arakh. I, 1</cite>, a. fr., v. supra.
<cite ref="Mishnah Arakhin 2:1">Ib. II, 1</cite> <he>אין נערכין</he> Var., v. <cite ref="P01377"><he>עֵרֶךְ</he></cite>.
